cookie_policy.hero.title: Cookie Policy
cookie_policy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how pyBIM uses cookies, local storage, and similar technologies on pybim.com. We prioritize user privacy and minimize data storage: our website operates without third-party advertising trackers or invasive cross-site profiling.
cookie_policy.iubenda.title: Third-Party Certified Cookie Document
cookie_policy.iubenda.desc: Our formal Cookie Policy is registered and maintained on the Iubenda compliance platform. Under the owner's free account tier, direct text embedding via JavaScript widget is not supported; the complete certified policy is accessible via the official link below:
cookie_policy.iubenda.button: View Certified Cookie Policy on Iubenda
cookie_policy.sec1.title: 1. What are Cookies and Local Storage?
cookie_policy.sec1.desc: Cookies and browser local storage are small data files stored on your device when you navigate a website. They allow the site to remember your preferences (such as dark/light theme and language selection) and ensure secure communication.
cookie_policy.sec2.title: 2. Categories of Storage Used on pybim.com
cookie_policy.sec2.desc: We categorize all browser storage technologies into two distinct groups:
cookie_policy.sec2.item1.title: Strictly Necessary Storage (Always Active):
cookie_policy.sec2.item1.desc: Required for the operation, technical integrity, and cybersecurity of the platform. These include:
cookie_policy.sec2.item1.bullet1: 'theme' (localStorage): Remembers your chosen theme (dark, light, or system).
cookie_policy.sec2.item1.bullet2: 'cookie_consent' (localStorage): Stores your explicit cookie preference selections so the banner is not displayed repeatedly.
cookie_policy.sec2.item1.bullet3: Cloudflare Turnstile verification cookies/tokens: Cryptographic challenge tokens generated by Cloudflare to protect contact and ROI calculator endpoints from bot abuse.
cookie_policy.sec2.item2.title: Analytics and Performance Storage (Optional):
cookie_policy.sec2.item2.desc: Intended for aggregated, non-profiling traffic measurement to evaluate platform performance. NOTE: Currently, pyBIM does not deploy active third-party analytics trackers (such as Google Analytics or Meta Pixel). The consent setting is provided to ensure full future-readiness and explicit user choice before any optional analytics tools are initialized.
cookie_policy.sec3.title: 3. Third-Party Integrations and Processors
cookie_policy.sec3.desc: Our public site interacts with the following technical service providers:
cookie_policy.sec3.item1: Cloudflare (Cloudflare Workers & Turnstile): Provides edge CDN infrastructure, DDoS protection, and privacy-preserving anti-bot challenge validation without cross-site tracking.
cookie_policy.sec3.item2: Resend: Transactional email delivery infrastructure for processing inbound contact and ROI inquiries submitted voluntarily by users.
cookie_policy.sec3.item3: Iubenda: Legal compliance documentation and policy hosting.
cookie_policy.sec4.title: 4. Managing and Revoking Your Consent
cookie_policy.sec4.desc: You have full control over your storage preferences at all times. You can open and adjust your choices at any moment:
cookie_policy.sec4.browser_info: You can also block or clear cookies directly within your web browser settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). Please note that disabling strictly necessary local storage may prevent the website from remembering your theme and language preferences.

cookie.modal.desc: Manage which storage technologies you allow. Strictly necessary technologies cannot be disabled as they are required for basic site security and navigation.
cookie.category.necessary.title: Strictly Necessary
cookie.category.necessary.desc: Essential for core navigation, security tokens, language preferences, and interface state.
cookie.category.analytics.title: Analytics & Performance
cookie.category.analytics.desc: Enables anonymous aggregated traffic measurement to evaluate platform performance. No cross-site tracking or advertising profiling. (Currently no external analytics trackers are active).
